name: Füzér (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Füzér (a blue shield with a white and blue checky, a castle, a patriarchal cross and a flower, supported by a serpent and a stag, within a wreath of oak, above a yellow scroll) below the words FÜZÉR KÖZSÉG in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Füzér arms with supporters, wreath and scroll
